mapper.select: select t1.ETL_JOB from etl_job_dependency t1 inner join etl_job t2 on t1.ETL_JOB = t2.ETL_JOB inner join etl_table_mapping t3 on t1.DEPENDENCY_JOB = t3.ETL_JOB where t3.TABLE_NAME = #{tableName} and t2.ENABLE = 1;
mapper.insert: insert into ssm_etl_job_info ( etl_job, last_end_time, created_time ) values ( #{etlJob}, #{lastEndTime}, now() )
mapper.update: update ssm_etl_job_info set last_end_time = #{lastEndTime}, updated_time = now() where etl_job = #{etlJob}
mapper.select: select count(1) from ssm_etl_job_info where etl_job = #{etlJob}
